generalCriterionList.description: Tenders from Joint ventures are not accepted.
The original documents should be produced for verification at any stage of tender process as and when sought for, failing which, the bids are liable for disqualification
Rates shall be quoted in tender in bill of quantities in the website itself.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
The tender document is part of the agreement.
The Bidder shall obtain insurance coverage for all the workers deployed for this work at his own cost.
The Bidder shall quote rates exclusive of GST and inclusive of all other applicable taxes, levies, duties and cess etc., as per the prevailing regulations of GOI and GOK .

Any variation in GST during the contract period upward/downward shall be paid or recovered. The contractor and KPCL are agreed for the same. All payments towards variation in GST shall be on production of documentary proof.

The bidder should take into account the prevailing royalty charges while quoting their rates and submit the Material Dispatch Permit(MDP) receipt, if not submitted penalty shall be levied as per statutory norms issued by GoK.
As per Building and other construction workers Welfare Cess Act 1995 1% Cess on bill amount shall be recovered in the work bills.
KPCL shall recover the statutory taxes such as Income Tax, cess, etc., at the prevailing applicable rates.
The contractor should get registration under section 7 & workers under section 12 of the building and other construction workers as per regulation of employment and condition of service act 1996.

The bidder should read the restrictions imposed by the Government of India & Government of Karnataka on procurement from bidders from a country or countries or class of countries which shares a land border with India and give the declaration for the same as per enclosed format. Any bidder from a country which shares a land with India will be eligible to bid in this tender only if the bidder is registered with the Competent Authority.

Bidders shall give declaration regarding payment of fair and reasonable wages, which shall not be less than the minimum wages fixed by the government from time to time to the labours working under the contractor in the contract undertaken by him, failing which the bids are liable for rejection.

In case of death of a contractor after executing the agreement/ commencement of the work, his legal heir (to be intimated at the time of execution of agreement by the successful contractor), if any eligible registered contractor and willing, can execute and complete the work at the accepted tender rates irrespective of the cost of the work after obtaining approval from competent authority.

Any dispute or difference or claim arising out of, or in connection with, or relating to the present contract or the breach, termination or invalidity thereof, shall be referred and settled under Arbitration center- Karnataka (domestic and international) rules 2012, by one or more arbitrators appointed in accordance with its rules.
In case the dates notified above are declared as holiday, the immediate next working day will be reckoned.
Defect liability/ Maintenance period for the work is 12 months from the date of completion of the work.
If the Bidder makes any alterations in the conditions of the contract or puts any condition of his own, such tenders are liable for rejection.
The bidders should read, understand, sign and shall upload the declarations along with the bid . The declarations are attached in the bid document.
In the item description in Schedule-B, the material to be used for the work should confirm with relevant IS standards. The material can be procured/used only after approval from Engineer in charge.

The location where the work is to be carried out is to be completely studied. Any electrical cables, power cables, transformers, OFC, etc., laid need to be understood. The safety of men, material, instruments is to be strictly taken care. Any lapse/incidents/accidents/loss is the total responsibility of bidder.

Security Deposit: Contract performance Guarantee: The Successful bidder shall furnish a Contract performance guarantee (CPG) equivalent to 5% of the tendered amount or contract price whichever is higher in the form of DD/RTGS/NEFT/e-BG/BG from any schedule bank acceptable to the Corporation in the prescribed format within 20 days of receipt of acceptance letter from KPCL and should be valid for 30days after the date of defect liability period including extension period if any.
The contract may be foreclosed/ extended beyond the original contract period as per the decision of KPCL.
Further details of the work or any clarifications can be obtained from the office of the Executive Engineer(Civil)Kodasalli, KPCL, Kadra(U.K) during office hours.
The corporation is not responsible for any delay in accessing Karnataka Public procurement Portal(KPPP).
Corrigendum/ modification/ corrections, if any, will be published in the web site only.

technicalCriterionList.description: Work experience: The intending bidder should have satisfactorily completed as a prime contractor in the last five financial years (i,e. 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26.), any similar Painting works to an extent of 50% of the cost of work of value not less than Rs.26.29Lakhs. The work done certificate issued from state / central Government / Government under taking from officers not below the rank of Executive Engineer or equivalent cadre shall be furnished. (Weightage of 10% per year will be given to the cost of completed works of previous years to bring them to the price level of present financial year).
Executed in any one year (for a continuous period of 12 months), the following minimum quantities of work:-Quantity of any similar Painting works-20705 square meter

Assessed available tender capacity (AxNx2.5-B) should be greater than the amount put to tender, where,A is Maximum value of works executed in any one year during the lastfive years (updated to 2026-27) price level taking into account the completed as well as works in progress.N is Number of years prescribed for completion of the works for which tenders are invited for 4Months (0.33 year).B is Value at 2026-27 price level, of existing commitments and on-going works to be completed during the next 4 Months.

Financial turnover: The intending bidder should have achieved in at least two financial years an average annual financial turnover of Rs.52.570Lakhs in the last five financial years i,e. 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26. Turnover certificate duly certified by the chartered accountant shall be furnished. (Weightage of 10% per year will be given to the financial turnover of previous years to bring them to the price level of present financial year).

Each Tenderer should further demonstrate :(i)Availability by owning the following key and critical equipment for this work Nil(ii)Liquid assets worth Rs.15.77 Lakhs (not less than 30% of the tender amount) in the form of credit line/line of credit/ certificates from banks for meeting the fund requirements etc.Note: The above documents shall be uploaded along with other documents, failing/not satisfying the above criteria the tenders are liable for rejection.

tenderSubEstimateList.subEstimateName: PAINTING TO KODASALLI POWER HOUSE AND OTHER STRUCTURES

itemList.description: Removing white or colour wash by scrapping and sand papering and preparing the surface smooth including necessary repairs to scratches etc. complete as per specifications and as per directions of Engineer in charge.

Providing 18 mm cement plaster in two coats under layer 12 mm thick cement plaster with cement mortar 1:5 (1 cement : 5 coarse sand) finished with a top layer 6 mm thick cement plaster with cement mortar 1:6 (1 cement : 6 fine sand) to brick masonry including rounding off corners wherever required smooth rendering, providing and removing scaffolding, including cost of materials, labour, curing complete as per specifications and as per directions of Engineer-in-charge

Wall painting with premium acrylic emulsion paint of interior grade, having VOC (Volatile Organic Compound ) content less than 50 g/L of approved brand and manufacture, including apply additional coats wherever required to achieve even shade and colour. Two coats as per specifications and as per directions of Engineer in charge

Finishing walls with 100% Premium acrylic emulsion paint having VOC less than 50 g/L and UV resistance as per IS 15489:2004, Alkali & fungal resistance, dirt resistance exterior paint of required shade (Company Depot Tinted) with silicon additives, New work (Two coats applied @ 1.43 L/ 10 m². Over and including priming coat of exterior primer applied @ 0.90 L/10 m² with paint of approved quality to give an even shade, after thoroughly brooming the surface to remove all dirt, dust, mortar drops and foreign matter including preparing the surface even and sand paper smooth, cost of materials, labour complete as per specifications and as per directions of Engineer-in-charge.

Finishing with Epoxy paint (two coats) at all locations prepared and applied as per manufacturer's specifications including appropriate priming coat, preparation of surface, etc. complete. On concrete work including preparing the surface after thorougly cleaning oil, grease, dirt and foreign matter, cost of materials, labour complete as per specifications and as per directions of Engineer-in-charge.

Painting with synthetic enamel paint of approved brand and manufacture to give an even shade :Two coats on new work after thoroughly brooming the surface to remove all dirt, dust, mortar drops and foreign matter including preparing the surface even and sand paper smooth, cost of materials, labour complete as per specifications and as per directions of Engineer-in-charge.
